name: The Velkash Crown
summary: The dominant power of the Crownlands: a merchant-state where the salt-and-harvest council elects a High Reeve every ten years. The Crown holds the King's Road, the Weavers' River trade, and the continent's deepest purse — and claims, on paper older than anyone alive, all of the Ashlands besides.

government.title: High Reeve
government.current: Reeve Aldara of the White Step
government.council: the salt-and-harvest council: grain magnates, silk-weavers, shipwrights, well-sisters (~40 seats)
government.note: Elected every ten years; the council can un-elect by two-thirds vote, which has happened four times.

population.note: stonewrights and smiths of Velkash's Thread

laws: Edict of Silence in force (written Old Weaver banned); Glimmerborn remanded to Censer custody under the Accords; certified cantrips witnessed only by the Oath-Sept.

relations.note: River tolls and grain prices are a permanent low war.
Every succession and major contract must pass Septuary clerks.
The Crown's map says the Ashlands are theirs. The Ashlands disagree.
The court is the Crown's executive body.
The Accords bind both; neither is happy about it.

history_notes: Crown Re-set (~120 AA) founded the modern council.
Solmere's fall (183 AA) forced the Accords granting the Censer its warrant — the Crown's oldest wound.
adventure_hooks: A council seat falls vacant; Wealdmark gold backs a candidate who will break the Accords.
The Crown quietly charters an expedition to Karvess that the Censer forbade — players are the crew.
Ashfall-poisoned grain threatens the dole; finding the source means crossing three realms' jurisdictions.
